monetite.identity: CaHPO4; IMA Ca(PO3OH), grandfathered G1882, not approval year; distinct hydrated brushite and whole dental composite. No criticality inherited.
monetite.primary: 10.3390/jfb13040232; Ionescu et al.2022; complete19-page original, JATS, all13 figures/4 tables and archive main figures inspected.
monetite.experiment: Synthetic TEGDMA-functionalized brushite RBC-20/RBC-40 resin composite surface, total60wt% filler; one-week saliva baseline, then48h live S.mutans ATCC35668 biofilm or filter-sterile acidic effluent from previous BIO runs. ACID is cell-free microbial spent broth, not fresh chemical acid.
monetite.locators: Methods2.1–2.4 and materials analyses; Figure8 and Table1 PDFp12; Table2/Figure9 thermal analysis; Discussionpp16–17. Separate2-week tooth microCT is not the disk assay.
monetite.supported: Brushite and monetite source-assigned on both BIO/ACID composite surfaces;1W brushite only and RBC-0 amorphous. Qualitative mixed-phase detection, not isolated monetite production.
limits: No quantitative phase fraction, phosphorus mass balance or monetite yield. Residual brushite TGA is not monetite recovery.
Both BIO materials have single+ monetite in Table1; ++ only RBC-40 ACID. General Results comparison is not a quantified BIO difference.
BIO cleaning/sonication and unspecified wet/dry diffraction handling constrain timing and cause; no pathway isolation.
XRD n=3 is not clearly allocated across conditions; do not transfer microbiology n=12.
No clinical efficacy or industrial deployment assertion.
Complete PDF/JATS plus retrieved media archive contain no separate supplementary experiments; underlying data on reasonable request.
monetite.taxonomy: NCBITaxon1309 species independently resolved; ATCC35668 collection webpage and primary support strain label, not authenticated actual culture.

switzerite.decision: curate qualified microbial assignment plus independent abiotic transformation
switzerite.identity: IMA Rd1966-042 Mn2+3(PO4)2(H2O)5·2H2O, ideal heptahydrate; distinct metaswitzerite tetrahydrate Rd1981-027a. White1986 redefinition is crucial because older switzerite crystallography refers to the tetrahydrate.
primaries: 10.5194/bg-10-3605-2013 complete10-page original/all5figures/5tables and1-page supplementary soil chemistry. Reused round68 original is not a fresh acquisition or independent study.
White,Leavens,Zanazzi1986 American Mineralogist71:1221–1223 complete3pages/Tables1–2 acquired legitimate RRUFF mirror.
switzerite.experiment: AM+20mM MnCl2 plates, five3µL spore drops,28°C56d sealed; four source-labeled positive strains E13/P10A-4/K7A-1/P9A-1. Formula/mineral label is source-assigned, no displayed switzerite-specific diffraction or hydration assay. Natural Fe-bearing specimen air dehydration is a separate1986 experiment.
switzerite.locators: Schutze Methods2.1–2.6, Table1, Figure1I–J, Results3.1/3.3 and Tables4–5; SI soil table. White1986pp1221–1223/Tables1–2.
switzerite.supported: Strain/medium-dependent source-assigned phosphate aggregates; growth-without-crystal nulls and no switzerite in soil agar retained. Natural wet switzerite rapidly transforms to metaswitzerite in air.
limits: No displayed culture switzerite powder pattern, refinement or water assay; Fig3 is manganese-bearing struvite, not switzerite.
SEM air drying and EMPA80°C drying versus unspecified XRD hydration handling; cannot infer exact alteration product from Fe-bearing natural specimen to nominal Fe-free culture.
Dead-biomass controls declared but switzerite-specific dead-control outcome not separately displayed. Uninoculated absence stated in discussion; pH chemistry is separate/proposed.
AM recipe delegated, phase-specific pH absent; duplicate plate/all-triplicate wording has unresolved nesting.
Table5 shows two switzerite-positive strains (TK23 and K7A1) versus abstract one; conclusions metal-resistance requirement conflicts with TK23. No unqualified count/resistance assertion adopted.
SI Csoil F1P16µg/g conflicts main all-P-below-detection statement; no source-concentration observations curated.
Natural-versus-synthetic dehydration differences retained; not universal hydration kinetics or recovery yield.
switzerite.taxonomy: NCBITaxon1883 genus independently verified; source species/strain labels kept without invented isolate/sequence accession.
